name: @lolly-tools/audio-dock
description: The shared, dependency-free audio-dock UI shell: ONE collapsible dock (Full/Compact/Mini) with a viz backdrop + scrim + controls face, driven by a DockHost adapter each host implements. Consumed by BOTH the Lolly web app (music/radio/atmosphere) and the static /info docs site (page narration), so the two players can never drift.
